description: Independent exact-source and syntax-shape inputs for the common native Tree-sitter provider. A provider must preserve all bytes, including comments, variations, whitespace and error spans. Source structure does not establish chess legality, completed playings or semantic admission.

expectation_contract.node_count_scope: All named nodes at every depth, counted by ts_language_symbol_name. Unlisted node types are not constrained. Zero is an exact absence expectation.
expectation_contract.error_or_missing_scope: Count nodes carrying the Tree-sitter ERROR or MISSING disposition. The optional bounds do not authorize loss or normalization of their exact source bytes.
expectation_contract.source_bytes: Exact UTF-8 Git blob byte count, including line endings and any terminal newline.
expectation_contract.source_readback: Require canonical source-root identity and exact byte readback through the existing native admission owner for each fixture; syntax node counts alone do not establish byte coverage.
expectation_contract.execution_status: Expectations authored from pinned upstream corpus trees or explicitly stated source structure. This manifest is not an execution receipt.

license_evidence.note: The pinned upstream source declares BSD-2-Clause but contains no complete license-notice file. Attribution here identifies the actual source; it does not invent or reproduce a missing upstream copyright notice.
